title: 第815章 阴皇风皇第814章 六座兵工厂
slug: 全民宗主合成亿万傀儡
content_zh:
看来对方是已经知道他在这座荒岛。
王海皱眉思索后，打开几座阵法道：“请进！”
王境阵法，哪怕布置的再好，一旦被皇境强者靠近，也能察觉出一些异样。
对方没有硬闯，也表明了善意。
很快，凤族二长老和龙族长老一起走了进来，在王境魂傀的引导下，来到王海所在的方向，避开了那两个正在突破的魂傀区域。
“二长老前来，所为何事？”王海没有起身，扫视一眼龙族长老后，看向凤族二长老询问道。
“我奉大长老之命，前来保护王海界主。”
这种时候，也没有什么要隐瞒的，直接说出来意，她也相信王海能够明白。
双方之间的交易还不能泄露出去，旁边有龙族长老在，也不好明说，好在王海并不傻，瞬间便明白对方的意思。
不过，他却直接拒绝道：“大长老的好意我心领了，只是我此番想要独自一人历练，不劳烦二长老陪同了。”
说完，没有等二长老继续交谈，他便看向旁边的龙族长老道：“不知龙皇山有何指教？”
此刻的龙族长老还处于震惊中。
他刚刚进入阵法，便被那引导他们走进来的魂傀吸引了注意，此刻看到王海身边还有近十只王境大圆满魂傀，更是被震惊的无以复加。
此刻面对王海的询问，他震惊中不由自主道：“敢问王海界主，这些可是魂傀？”
魂傀？
凤族二长老听到这话，顿时将目光放到那些魂傀上。
这仔细一看，顿时大惊。
居然和传说中的魂傀真的有很多相似之处。
王海没有否认，点了点头承认这个结果，然后略有不满道：“龙皇山安排人跟踪我，此举我不喜欢，还请离开。”
这是下了逐客令啊！

龙族长老不舍的收回目光，看向王海拱手道：“王海界主息怒，我龙族并无恶意。此次前来也是奉大长老之命，确保您的安全。”
“哦？是确保我的安全，还是要安全的带着我回到龙皇山？”
王海一语点破，对方有些尴尬的笑道：“王海界主言重了，我龙皇山对炎黄山并无恶意。”
“你们的善意我收到了，只是此番我独自历练，不想要有人在旁保护，这不利于我的历练。所以，还请龙凤两族带着你们的人离开。否则，我可能会将你们当做敌人。”
当做敌人？
此话一出，两位长老都脸色一凝，心中一沉。
一个金仙境的小世界界主，居然敢如何对他们两个仙皇境强者？
这种不客气的发言，几乎等同于挑衅和宣战了。
只是看到那四周十余只王境大圆满魂傀，他们又忍住不满的情绪，思索后沉声道：“王海界主，若是我们所料不差，你此番历练之地乃是前往王境墓地和陨皇山，这一路上要面对很多危险，甚至有很多皇境敌人。仅仅凭借这些王境魂傀，恐怕并不能保证你的安全。”
“这就不劳你们费心了。皇境而已，不久前刚在此地陨落一个，似乎也不过如此。”
龙凤二位长老顿时大惊失色，瞳孔紧缩。
他们都感到一股寒气从头顶冒出。
什么意思？
你这话是什么意思？
那魔族皇境长老是你杀的？
不！
不可能！
仅仅凭借你金仙境实力和十来只王境大圆满，根本做不到。
可这话的意思却释放了一个令他们胆寒的信号。
哪怕不是王海杀的，也和他有脱不开的关系。

怪不得毫不畏惧他们进入荒岛，并且对他们没有丝毫的尊敬，原来是有底气。
这底气来自哪里？
难道是......秦皇？
content_en:
It seemed that the other party already knew that he was on this desert island.
After Wang Hai frowned and thought, he opened several formations and said, "Please come in!"
No matter how well-arranged the King Realm formation is, once a King Realm expert approaches, something strange will be detected.
The other party did not force his way in and showed goodwill.
Soon, the second elder of the Phoenix Clan and the elder of the Dragon Clan walked in together. Under the guidance of the King Realm Soul Puppet, they came to the direction of Wang Hai, avoiding the area where the two soul puppets were breaking through.
"Why did the second elder come here?" Wang Hai did not stand up. After glancing at the dragon elder, he looked at the second elder of the phoenix clan and asked.
"I am here to protect Wanghai Realm Master on the order of the Great Elder."
At this time, there was nothing to hide. She just said her intention directly, and she believed that Wang Hai would understand.
The transaction between the two parties cannot be leaked yet, and it is difficult to explain it clearly with the dragon clan elders nearby. Fortunately, Wang Hai is not stupid, and he understands what the other party means in an instant.
However, he directly refused: "I understand the great elder's kindness, but I want to practice alone this time, so I won't bother the second elder to accompany me."
After saying that, without waiting for the second elder to continue the conversation, he looked at the dragon elder next to him and said, "I wonder if Longhuang Mountain has any advice?"
At this moment, the dragon clan elders were still in shock.
As soon as he entered the formation, his attention was attracted by the soul puppet that led them in. At this moment, he saw nearly ten king-level Dzogchen soul puppets beside Wang Hai, and he was even more shocked.
Facing Wang Hai's inquiry at this moment, he couldn't help but said in shock: "Dare I ask Realm Master Wang Hai, are these soul puppets?"
Soul puppet?
When the second elder of the Feng Clan heard this, he immediately turned his attention to those soul puppets.
When I took a closer look, I was shocked.
There are actually many similarities with the legendary soul puppet.
Wang Hai did not deny it, nodded and acknowledged the result, and then said slightly dissatisfied: "Longhuang Mountain arranged for people to follow me. I don't like this move, so please leave."
This is an eviction order!
The elder of the dragon clan reluctantly withdrew his gaze, looked at Wang Hai and cupped his hands and said: "Master Wang Hai, please calm down, I, the dragon clan, have no ill intentions. I am here under the order of the great elder to ensure your safety."
"Oh? Do you want to ensure my safety, or do you want to take me back to Dragon Emperor Mountain safely?"
Wang Hai pointed it out, and the other party smiled awkwardly and said: "Wang Hai Realm Master made a strong statement. I, Longhuang Mountain, have no ill intentions towards Yanhuang Mountain."
"I have received your kindness, but this time I am practicing alone and do not want anyone to protect me. This is not conducive to my experience. Therefore, please ask the dragon and phoenix tribes to take your people away. Otherwise, I may regard you as enemies."
As an enemy?
As soon as these words came out, the two elders' expressions froze and their hearts sank.
How dare a small world master from the Golden Immortal Realm do anything to these two Immortal Emperor Realm experts?
Such rude remarks are almost tantamount to provocation and declaration of war.
Just seeing the dozen or so King Realm Dzogchen Soul Puppets around them, they suppressed their dissatisfaction and said in a deep voice after thinking: "King Hai Realm Master, if our expectations are correct, the place for your training this time is to go to the King Realm Cemetery and the Fallen Emperor Mountain. You will face many dangers along the way, and there are even many Emperor Realm enemies. Just relying on these King Realm soul puppets may not guarantee your safety."
"I don't need you to worry about it. It's just the Imperial Realm. One of them just died here not long ago. It seems to be nothing more than that."
The two elders, Dragon and Phoenix, were immediately shocked and their pupils tightened.
They all felt a chill coming from their heads.
What's the meaning?
What do you mean?
Were you the one who killed the demon emperor realm elder?
No!
impossible!
Just relying on your Golden Immortal Realm strength and the ten or so King Realm Dzogchen Perfection, you simply can’t do it.
But the meaning of these words sent a signal that made them frightened.
Even if it wasn't Wang Hai who killed him, it was still inseparable from him.
No wonder you are not afraid of themEntering a deserted island and not showing any respect to them turned out to be a source of confidence.
Where does this confidence come from?
Could it be... Emperor Qin?
